She reverts at 50 Hit Points or fewer, and each creature in a 30-foot Emanation (Constructs and Undead succeed automatically) makes a DC 14 Wis save or is Frightened for 1 minute, with Disadvantage on saves while Frightened.

legendaryActions.name: Brand
legendaryActions.description: Teleports up to 30 feet and can make one Mother's Brand attack.

legendaryActions.name: Overwhelming Presence
legendaryActions.description: Casts Slow. Can't be used again until the start of her next turn.

monster:chakuna.speed: 30 ft., 50 ft. (panther form only), climb 40 ft. (panther form only)

traits.name: Darklord Restoration
traits.description: If Chakuna dies with her heart intact, she revives with all her Hit Points in 1d10 weeks somewhere in Valachan. Her heart is a Tiny object (AC 17, HP 10, immune to all damage but Fire).

traits.name: Experienced Hunter
traits.description: Undergrowth Difficult Terrain costs her no extra movement.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Domain)
traits.description: If Chakuna fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three attacks, using Scratch or Barbed Spear in any combination. She can replace one with a Bite attack.

actions.name: Bite (Panther or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 20 (3d10 + 4) Piercing. A Humanoid target makes a DC 15 Con save. Fail: cursed; if it drops to 0 Hit Points it instead becomes a werepanther (Weretiger stat block) under the DM's control with 10 Hit Points. Success: immune to her curse for 24 hours.

actions.name: Scratch
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing.

actions.name: Barbed Spear (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee or Ranged attack, +8, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft.; 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing and a dire wound if it has none: Speed -10 feet and loses 5 (1d10) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns, until 1 minute passes, magical healing, or a DC 15 Medicine check as an action by it or a creature within 5 feet. The spear returns to her hand after a ranged attack.

bonusActions.name: Prowl (Panther or Hybrid Form Only)
bonusActions.description: Moves up to her Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then can Hide.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.description: Becomes a Large panther-humanoid hybrid or a Large panther, or returns to humanoid form; statistics other than size are unchanged and gear doesn't transform.

legendaryActions.name: Pounce
legendaryActions.description: One Scratch attack.

legendaryActions.name: Strike from Shadows
legendaryActions.description: One Barbed Spear attack that doesn't end her Invisible condition from Hide. Can't be used again until the start of her next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Sudden Bite
legendaryActions.description: Shifts to hybrid or panther form and makes one Bite attack. Can't be used again until the start of her next turn.

monster:bodytaker-podling.languages: Deep Speech plus one other language

traits.name: Semblance of Life
traits.description: A copy of a creature digested by a Bodytaker Plant; Advantage on Deception checks to pass as that creature. Melts into slurry when it dies.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning.

traits.name: Podling Link
traits.description: Sees through and telepathically talks with its podlings within 10 miles; they die when it dies.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If it dies, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 days, unless Poison damage killed it or its remains are salted.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three Vine attacks. It can replace one with Entrapping Pod.

actions.name: Vine
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 20 ft.; 17 (3d8 + 4) Slashing, and a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) from one of four vines.

actions.name: Entrapping Pod
actions.description: DC 15 Str save, one Large or smaller creature it is grappling. Fail: pulled into its pod, Blinded and Paralyzed with Total Cover; after 2d4 hours the target dies and a Humanoid becomes a Bodytaker Podling. A creature within 5 feet can use an action and a DC 14 Athletics check to pull it out Prone. If the plant dies, the target can escape with 5 feet of movement.

reactions.name: Transfer Harm
reactions.description: When hit while a podling is within 5 feet, it halves the damage and the podling takes the other half.

traits.name: Abduct
traits.description: Moving a creature it is grappling costs no extra movement.

traits.name: Compression
traits.description: Moves through a space 1 inch wide without extra movement.

actions.name: Smother
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 12): Blinded, Restrained, suffocating, and taking 7 (2d4 + 2) Bludgeoning at the start of each of the boneless's turns. One target at a time.

bonusActions.name: Unraveling Flesh (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: DC 11 Wis save, each creature within 30 feet that can see it. Fail: Frightened. Then it moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

monster:brain-in-a-jar.languages: Understands Common plus three other languages but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft.

traits.name: Detect Intelligence
traits.description: Senses the location of any creature with Intelligence 3 or higher within 300 feet, through barriers.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Disrupting Burst attacks.

actions.name: Disrupting Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged attack, +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft.; 11 (2d6 + 4) Psychic, and until the end of its next turn the target can't take Reactions and has Disadvantage on Concentration saves.

actions.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: DC 14 Int save, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Fail: 14 (4d6) Psychic and Incapacitated until the end of the brain's next turn. Success: half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Intelligence, save DC 14, no components. At will: Charm Person, Detect Thoughts, Mage Hand. 1/day each: Compulsion, Hold Person (level 3).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Tentacle attacks and one Stinger attack.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing, and it attaches to the target, making Tentacle attacks only against it. It detaches with 5 feet of movement; the target or a creature within 5 feet can pull it off as an action.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.description: Melee attack, +5 (Advantage if attached to the target), reach 5 ft.; 7 (2d6) Poison, and the target makes a DC 13 Con save. Fail: Poisoned and infested with a larva; if still Poisoned after 24 hours, a Carrion Stalker bursts out and kills it.

actions.name: Silver Needle
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 1 Piercing plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic. A Humanoid not already cursed by a carrionette makes a DC 11 Cha save or is cursed for 1 minute: Poisoned and -10 feet Speed.

actions.name: Soul Swap (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: DC 11 Cha save, one Humanoid it can see within 15 feet cursed by its Silver Needle. Fail: they swap bodies and the target is Unconscious for 1 hour. Each keeps its alignment, personality, Int, Wis, Cha and languages but uses the other body's statistics (the target can't Soul Swap). The swap ends if the target, in the carrionette's body, damages its own original body with Silver Needle. If either body is destroyed, both die.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of reach.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +3, reach 5 ft.; 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of reach.

actions.name: Brain-Rending Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +3, reach 5 ft.; 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing plus 3 (1d6) Psychic, and the target is Frightened until the start of the death's head's next turn.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of reach.

actions.name: Petrifying Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +3, reach 5 ft.; 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic, and the target makes a DC 11 Con save. First failure: Restrained, repeating the save at the end of its next turn. Second failure: Petrified for 10 minutes instead.

traits.name: Overhanging Branches
traits.description: Allies can end their moves in its space and have Half Cover there.

traits.name: Unholy Regrowth
traits.description: If it dies, 2d6 Death's Head Trees regrow nearby in 365 days, unless it was slain with a Slashing weapon by a creature under Bless.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +6, reach 10 ft.; 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning.

actions.name: Exploding Head
actions.description: DC 14 Dex save, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet. Fail: 10 (3d6) Necrotic and Poisoned until the start of the tree's next turn. Success: half damage.

bonusActions.name: Head Fruits
bonusActions.description: Each Undead ally in its space can use a Reaction to gain 5 Temporary Hit Points.

monster:dullahan.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

traits.name: Mounted Adept
traits.description: While mounted and not Incapacitated, it and its mount have Advantage on Dex saves, and it can redirect attacks against its mount to itself.

traits.name: Terrorizer
traits.description: Advantage on attack rolls against Frightened targets.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two attacks, using Beheading Blade or Fiery Skull in any combination, and uses Headless Wail.

actions.name: Beheading Blade
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic. A target killed by this is beheaded, and its head rises as a Death's Head under the dullahan's control (up to seven).

actions.name: Fiery Skull
actions.description: Ranged attack, +7, range 120 ft.; 18 (4d8) Fire.

actions.name: Headless Wail
actions.description: DC 15 Con save, up to three non-Construct, non-Undead creatures within 120 feet. Fail: 13 (2d12) Psychic and Frightened until the start of its next turn. Success: half damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Soothing Tentacle attacks, and uses Psychic Skewer.

actions.name: Soothing Tentacle
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 10 ft.; 14 (2d8 + 5) Psychic, and the target is Charmed until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Mind-Scouring Spores (Recharge 6)
actions.description: DC 18 Int save, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation. Fail: 55 (10d10) Psychic, and for 1 minute it takes 10 (3d6) Psychic whenever it takes the Magic action. Success: half damage.

actions.name: Psychic Skewer
actions.description: DC 18 Wis save, one creature within 60 feet. Fail: 22 (4d10) Psychic; a Charmed target also gains 1 Exhaustion level and is Stunned while Charmed.

bonusActions.name: Eldritch Magic (3/Day)
bonusActions.description: Casts Command, Detect Thoughts, Gust of Wind or Nondetection with no components (Intelligence, DC 18).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three attacks, using Hunter's Blade or Fiery Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Hunter's Blade
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 5 ft.; 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing plus 11 (2d10) Radiant.

actions.name: Fiery Bolt
actions.description: Ranged attack, +7, range 120 ft.; 19 (3d10 + 3) Fire.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Intelligence, save DC 15, no Material components. At will: Light, Mage Hand. 1/day each: Dispel Evil and Good, Lightning Bolt, Magic Circle.

bonusActions.name: Bolster Allies
bonusActions.description: Up to six allies within 60 feet that can hear her gain either Advantage on their next attack roll before the end of their next turn or Resistance to Acid, Necrotic and Poison until the end of their next turn.

bonusActions.name: Curse of the All-Seeing Eye (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: Choose a damage type; one creature she can see within 30 feet makes a DC 15 Wis save or gains Vulnerability to it until she uses this again. If the target drops to 0 Hit Points first, she can curse a new creature as a later Bonus Action.

bonusActions.name: Inspiring Rally
bonusActions.description: Up to six allies within 60 feet that can hear her can use a Reaction to move up to their Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

reactions.name: Shield (3/Day)
reactions.description: Casts Shield.

monster:gallows-speaker.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Aura of Violence
traits.description: At the end of each of its turns, creatures of its choice in a 15-foot Emanation make a DC 15 Wis save. Fail: the creature uses its Reaction to make a melee attack against a creature in reach, or takes 7 (2d6) Psychic if none is in reach.

traits.name: Whirling Form
traits.description: Can enter and stop in a creature's space.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Whirling Blades attacks.

actions.name: Whirling Blades
actions.description: Melee or Ranged attack, +6, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft.; 13 (3d6 + 3) Slashing plus 7 (3d4) Necrotic.

actions.name: Howling Wind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: DC 15 Con save, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Fail: 18 (4d8) Thunder and Frightened for 1 minute; while Frightened it is Deafened, shrieks along, and can't cast Verbal spells (repeat save each turn end). Success: half damage.

monster:gremishka.conditionImmunities: charmed (swarm form only), frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Swarm (Swarm Form Only)
traits.description: Can share spaces and squeeze through Tiny openings; can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Bite (Individual Form Only)
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing plus 7 (2d6) Force.

actions.name: Swarming Bites (Swarm Form Only)
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 12 (3d6 + 2) Piercing, or 9 (3d4 + 2) while Bloodied, plus 7 (2d6) Force, and the target's Attunement to one magic item (DM's choice) ends.

reactions.name: Magic Allergy (Individual Form Only; 1/Day)
reactions.description: When a creature within 30 feet casts a spell, it regains 15 Hit Points and becomes a Medium swarm of Tiny creatures.

monster:gug.languages: Understands Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: Advantage on attack rolls against a creature with a non-Incapacitated ally of the gug within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Claw attacks, and uses Chew.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 10 ft.; 22 (3d10 + 6) Slashing, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 16) from one of two claws.

actions.name: Chew
actions.description: DC 18 Dex save, up to two Medium or smaller creatures it has Grappled. Fail: placed in its mouth (up to four): no longer Grappled but Restrained, Half Cover from other effects, and 10 (3d6) Piercing at the start of each of the gug's turns. A DC 16 Athletics check as an action frees it to a space within 5 feet; if the gug dies, it escapes with 5 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

traits.name: Jiangshi Weaknesses
traits.description: Fear of Its Own Reflection: on seeing its reflection, it uses its Reaction to move as far from it as possible. Susceptible to Holy Symbols: while wearing or touching a Holy Symbol, it loses its Frightened immunity and automatically fails saves against Frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three Slam attacks, and uses Consume Energy.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning.

actions.name: Consume Energy
actions.description: DC 16 Con save, one creature it can see within 30 feet. Fail: 18 (4d8) Necrotic. Success: half damage. It regains HP equal to the Necrotic dealt, its Fly Speed becomes 20 feet until the end of its next turn, and it can use Hungering Stride. A Humanoid slain this way rises at the end of its turn as a Wight under its control; if that Wight kills a Humanoid with Life Drain, it becomes an independent Jiangshi 5 days later.

bonusActions.name: Hungering Stride (Requires Consume Energy)
bonusActions.description: Takes the Dash action.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.description: Becomes a Medium or Small Beast, Humanoid or Undead, or returns to its true form; statistics other than size are unchanged and gear doesn't transform.

monster:loup-garou.speed: 30 ft., 40 ft. (hybrid form only), 50 ft. (dire wolf form only)
monster:loup-garou.languages: Common (can't speak in dire wolf form)

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If the loup garou fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two attacks, using Longsword or Rend in any combination. It can replace one with a Bite attack.

actions.name: Bite (Dire Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee attack, +12, reach 5 ft.; 16 (2d8 + 7) Piercing plus 14 (4d6) Necrotic. A Humanoid target makes a DC 18 Con save. Fail: cursed; if it drops to 0 Hit Points it instead becomes a Werewolf under the DM's control with 10 Hit Points, and the curse lasts until this loup garou dies. Success: immune to its curse for 24 hours.

actions.name: Longsword (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee attack, +12, reach 5 ft.; 18 (2d10 + 7) Slashing plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic.

actions.name: Rend (Dire Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.description: Melee attack, +12, reach 5 ft.; 16 (2d8 + 7) Slashing, and a Medium or smaller target is Prone.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.description: Becomes a Large dire wolf-humanoid hybrid or a Large dire wolf, or returns to humanoid form; statistics other than size are unchanged and gear doesn't transform.

legendaryActions.name: Mauling Charge
legendaryActions.description: One Longsword or Rend attack.

legendaryActions.name: Surprise Bite
legendaryActions.description: Shifts to hybrid or dire wolf form and makes one Bite attack. Can't be used again until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three attacks, using Cursed Dagger or Radiant Flame in any combination.

actions.name: Cursed Dagger
actions.description: Melee attack, +9, reach 5 ft.; 10 (2d4 + 5) Piercing plus 21 (6d6) Necrotic.

actions.name: Radiant Flame
actions.description: Ranged attack, +9, range 60 ft.; 21 (3d10 + 5) Radiant, and the target is Blinded until the start of her next turn.

actions.name: Apocalyptic Visions (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: DC 17 Wis save, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere within 120 feet. Fail: 24 (7d6) Necrotic plus 24 (7d6) Psychic and Frightened until the start of her next turn. Success: half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Wisdom, save DC 17. At will: Light, Mending, Thaumaturgy. 2/day each: Dispel Magic, Remove Curse. 1/day each: Greater Restoration, Raise Dead, Scrying, Spirit Guardians (level 8).

bonusActions.name: Evil Eye (2/Day)
bonusActions.description: Casts Hold Person.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Silver Canister
traits.description: While carrying its canister (AC 15, HP 40, resistant to all damage) it can Extract Brain. If the canister breaks, the brains inside are destroyed; it can make a new one in 7 days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Pincer attacks. It can replace one with Dazing Ray.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.description: Melee attack, +9, reach 5 ft.; 23 (4d8 + 5) Slashing plus 16 (3d10) Acid, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 15) from one of two pincers.

actions.name: Dazing Ray (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: DC 17 Dex save, one creature it can see within 60 feet. Fail: 22 (4d10) Lightning plus 10 (3d6) Force and Stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Extract Brain (Requires Silver Canister)
actions.description: DC 17 Con save, one creature it has Grappled or that is Stunned. Fail: 77 (14d10) Piercing. Success: half damage. A creature slain this way has its brain removed into the canister.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Intelligence, save DC 17, no components. 1/day each: Modify Memory, Plane Shift (self only).

monster:mist-horror.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

traits.name: Air Form
traits.description: Can enter and stop in an enemy's space and squeeze through a 1-inch gap without extra movement.

traits.name: One with the Mists
traits.description: Invisible while in fog or mist; Incapacitated while outside fog or mist.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Mind Rend attacks. It can replace one with Spellcasting to cast Command.

actions.name: Mind Rend
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 8 (1d10 + 3) Psychic.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Charisma, save DC 13, no components. At will: Fog Cloud. 1/day: Command.

bonusActions.name: Instill Dread (Recharge 4-6)
bonusActions.description: DC 13 Wis save, each creature in its space. Fail: Frightened until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Death Curse
traits.description: When it dies, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation makes a DC 13 Cha save or is cursed: Blinded and Deafened.

traits.name: Mist Walker
traits.description: Travels safely through the Mists to a domain it knows by name, but can't cross borders a Darklord has closed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Radiant Burst attacks. It can replace one with Spellcasting to cast Mind Spike.

actions.name: Radiant Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged attack, +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft.; 14 (2d10 + 3) Radiant.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Wisdom, save DC 13. At will: Light, Mage Hand. 1/day each: Augury, Detect Magic, Mind Spike.

bonusActions.name: Evil Eye (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: Casts Hold Person.

monster:mordenheim-s-monster.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Greater Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Lightning damage heals it by the amount dealt and adds 40 feet to its Speed until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: Can't shape-shift.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Slam attacks, and uses Crush or Throw.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 5 ft.; 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) Lightning, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 18) from one of two hands.

actions.name: Crush
actions.description: DC 18 Str save, one creature it has Grappled. Fail: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) Lightning, and Restrained and suffocating.

actions.name: Throw
actions.description: Throws a creature it has Grappled to a grounded space within 30 feet; it and each creature there make a DC 18 Dex save. Fail: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning and Prone. Success: half damage.

bonusActions.name: Violent Leap
bonusActions.description: Spends 10 feet of movement to leap to a space within 40 feet holding Medium or smaller creatures; each makes a DC 18 Dex save. Fail: 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning and Prone. Either way they move to the nearest unoccupied space.

monster:necrichor.languages: Common plus two other languages; telepathy 120 ft.
monster:necrichor.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: Moves through a 1-inch space without extra movement.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.description: If the necrichor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Reborn by Blood
traits.description: If destroyed, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 days next to a creature it once possessed, unless its remains are in a vessel under Hallow or all its past hosts are dead.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Necrotic Burst attacks.

actions.name: Necrotic Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged attack, +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft.; 12 (2d8 + 3) Force plus 11 (2d10) Necrotic, and the target is Poisoned and can't regain Hit Points until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Blood Puppeteering (Recharge 6)
actions.description: DC 15 Con save, one Bloodied creature within 5 feet (Constructs and Undead succeed). Fail: it vanishes into the target and controls its body while the target stays aware but Incapacitated; it can be affected only by effects that target Undead and uses the host's Speed, Str, Dex and Con. It ends when the host drops to 0 HP or it leaves as a Bonus Action, reappearing within 5 feet. Either way the target is then immune for 24 hours.

monster:nightgaunt.languages: Understands Deep Speech but can't speak

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two attacks, using Claw or Barb in any combination. It can replace one with Ascend.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing plus 10 (3d6) Poison, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 13).

actions.name: Barb
actions.description: Ranged attack, +8, range 60 ft.; 21 (6d6) Piercing, and the target is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Ascend
actions.description: Flies straight up its full Fly Speed, carrying a grappled creature at no extra cost.

bonusActions.name: Tickle
bonusActions.description: DC 16 Wis save, one creature it has Grappled. Fail: Incapacitated until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Tattoo of Osybus
traits.description: When reduced to 0 Hit Points, it revives at the start of its next turn with half its HP as an Undead and gains a random boon (1d6): 1 Dread (non-Undead starting their turn in a 15-foot Emanation make a DC 15 Wis save or are Frightened until their next turn); 2 Ectoplasmic (creatures starting their turn in a 15-foot Emanation make a DC 15 Str save or lose 10 feet of Speed); 3 Vampiric (temp HP equal to Necrotic it deals); 4 Blazing (Fly 30 and Fire immunity); 5 Spectral (resists Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing, vulnerable to Radiant, incorporeal movement); 6 Deathly (Small or Medium Humanoid corpses within 30 feet rise as Skeletons under its control, and non-Undead within 5 feet take 5 (1d10) Necrotic at the end of its turns). It dies instead if it rolls a boon it has or its tattoo is destroyed (15+ damage in one turn while at 0 HP).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two attacks, using Soul Blade or Necrotic Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Soul Blade
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 5 ft.; 9 (2d4 + 4) Piercing, and the target is Paralyzed until the start of its next turn. A Medium or smaller creature slain by this has its soul trapped in a tattoo on the priest until the priest dies.

actions.description: If all three hags target the same Fungal Trolling within 60 feet with this (keeping Concentration until the third acts), it becomes a Humongous Fungus Troll; the trolling is Paralyzed meanwhile, and broken Concentration means starting over without losing the use.

actions.name: Vexing Curse
actions.description: Intelligence save DC 16: 19 (3d10 + 3) Psychic and Jinxed (1d6) (save ends) on failure.

traits.name: Absorbing Flesh
traits.description: A creature it reduces to 0 Hit Points is absorbed and dies, and the growth grows one size; after a Long Rest without absorbing anyone, it shrinks one size.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two attacks while Medium, three while Large, four while Huge, five while Gargantuan.

actions.name: Assimilating Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 10 ft.; 14 (2d8 + 5) Necrotic, and a smaller target makes a DC 16 Dexterity save or is swallowed: Blinded, Restrained, Total Cover from outside, and 18 (4d8) Necrotic at the start of each of the growth's turns, which heals the growth (excess raising its Hit Point maximum). If it takes 20 or more damage in one turn from inside, it makes a DC 17 Constitution save at the end of that turn or regurgitates everyone Prone within 10 feet. If it dies, a swallowed creature can escape using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

reactions.name: Adaptable Flesh
reactions.description: Halves the damage of a spell or attack that damages it.

monster:undulating-polyp.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone

traits.name: Displacement
traits.description: Attacks against it have Disadvantage; after it takes damage this stops until the start of its next turn, and it is suppressed while it is Incapacitated, Restrained, or otherwise unable to move.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Mucus attacks.

actions.name: Mucus
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +6, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft.; 13 (3d6 + 3) Acid, and acidic slime covers a 5-foot radius around the target for 1 minute. Another creature entering it for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a DC 15 Constitution save or takes 10 (3d6) Acid and has the Burning condition (3d6 Acid).

actions.name: Slip Space
actions.description: Teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 20 feet; each creature in a 10-foot Emanation where it reappears makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 16 (3d10) Force (half on success) and triggering an Arcane Anomaly on itself on a failure by 5 or more.

bonusActions.name: Shift Step
bonusActions.description: Teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

reactions.name: Confused Realities
reactions.description: When a creature it can see within 30 feet damages it, that creature is teleported to an unoccupied space the polyp can see within 30 feet of its original space, on a surface or liquid that supports it without squeezing.

traits.name: From Another World
traits.description: Lacks the standard Aberrant Traits of creatures from the Space Between Worlds.

traits.name: Keen Eye, Sharp Wit
traits.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three attacks.

actions.name: Void Longsword
actions.description: Melee attack, +9, reach 5 ft.; 21 (3d10 + 5) Force.

actions.name: Pirate Pistol
actions.description: Ranged attack, +9, range 30/120 ft.; 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing.

bonusActions.name: Bark Orders
bonusActions.description: One void pirate squib or quartermaster within 60 feet can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed or make an attack.

reactions.name: Captain's Command (2/Day)
reactions.description: When a friendly creature within 30 feet that can hear it misses with an attack, that creature can reroll and use the higher result.

traits.name: From Another World
traits.description: Lacks the standard Aberrant Traits of creatures from the Space Between Worlds.

traits.name: Magical Chaos
traits.description: When it or a creature within 30 feet is targeted by a spell, roll a d6: on 4-5 an Arcane Anomaly triggers on the caster; on 6 the spell also fails.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three Void Blast attacks.

actions.name: Void Blast
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft.; 19 (3d10 + 3) Force, and the target is knocked 10 feet away.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Intelligence, save DC 14, +6 to hit, no Material components. At will: Mage Armor (included in AC), Mage Hand, Prestidigitation. 2/day each: Chromatic Orb, Faerie Fire, Heat Metal. 1/day each: Arcane Eye, Black Tentacles, Fly.

bonusActions.name: Summon Elemental (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: Summons an obedient Entropic Flame, Walking Geode, Living Deep Haze, or Animated Delerium Sludge within 60 feet that acts right after it for 1 hour, until either dies, or until dismissed as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Captain's Orders
traits.description: Within 60 feet of a void pirate captain, it has Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed and Frightened.

traits.name: Duel to the Death
traits.description: Once per turn, when it is within 5 feet of one enemy and no other creatures are within 5 feet of it, its Voidblade deals an extra 10 (3d6) Slashing.

traits.name: From Another World
traits.description: Lacks the standard Aberrant Traits of creatures from the Space Between Worlds.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two attacks.

actions.name: Voidblade
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 5 ft.; 18 (3d8 + 4) Force.

actions.name: Boltgun
actions.description: Ranged attack, +6, range 150/600 ft.; 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing and Slowed until the end of the target's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Bark Orders
bonusActions.description: One void pirate squib within 60 feet can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed or make an attack.

traits.name: Captain's Orders
traits.description: Within 60 feet of a void pirate captain, it has Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed and Frightened.

traits.name: From Another World
traits.description: Lacks the standard Aberrant Traits of creatures from the Space Between Worlds.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Void Cutlass attacks, or it uses Sturdy Net.

actions.name: Void Cutlass
actions.description: Melee attack, +6, reach 5 ft.; 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing.

actions.name: Sturdy Net
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +6, reach 5 ft. or range 15/30 ft.; the target is Restrained and Defenseless. An action and a DC 14 Strength check frees a creature, as does dealing 10 Slashing damage to the net (AC 12), which destroys it.

bonusActions.name: Man the Cannons
bonusActions.description: Loads an artillery weapon such as a cannon or ballista.

monster:walking-delerium-geode.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.; passive Perception 10

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: If it dies without having taken Force, Radiant, or Thunder damage since its last turn, it explodes: each creature in a 30-foot Emanation makes a DC 16 Constitution save or takes 42 (12d6) Necrotic and a Contamination level, and a random Arcane Anomaly triggers either way.

traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.description: Burrows through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Shard Slam attacks.

actions.name: Shard Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 10 ft.; 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning, and the target makes a DC 16 Constitution save or takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic and gains one Contamination level.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While motionless, it looks like an inanimate statue.

traits.name: Faultless Tracker
traits.description: The creature that woke it becomes its quarry; it knows the quarry's direction and distance while it remains in Drakkenheim or until the gargoyle is destroyed.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: If destroyed, it reforms with full Hit Points in 1 hour unless Disintegrate is cast on its remains.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Bite and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.description: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing.

actions.name: Balefire
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft.; 21 (4d8 + 3) Necrotic and the Burning condition (2d8 Necrotic).

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Charisma, save DC 13, no Material components. At will: Mage Armor (self only; included in AC), Minor Illusion, Thaumaturgy. 1/day each: Augury, Dispel Magic, Invisibility, Major Image.

actions.name: Conjure Swarms (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: Two Swarms of Rats appear within 60 feet, acting right after it, for 1 minute or until destroyed.

bonusActions.name: Teleport
bonusActions.description: Teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet.

traits.name: Aberrant Traits
traits.description: Has the Aberrant Traits described in Monsters of Drakkenheim.

traits.name: Extraplanar Gullet
traits.description: A mouth on its back leads to an extradimensional maze of fleshy tunnels holding any number of creatures of any size, which can't harm it from inside. A creature inside can use an action to make a DC 15 Intelligence save, reappearing within 5 feet on a success or taking 10 (3d6) Psychic on a failure. If it dies, everything inside appears near its corpse.

traits.name: Grasping Tentacles
traits.description: It has up to four tentacles, each AC 20, 10 Hit Points, immune to Poison and Psychic; destroying one doesn't harm it and it regrows one next turn. A creature within 5 feet can use an action and a DC 15 Strength check to break a tentacle.

traits.name: Swirling Color Field
traits.description: A creature that hits it with an attack (unless grappled and adjacent) suffers a random effect (1d6): 1-2 Blue (teleported to a supporting space it can see within 20 feet, then a DC 15 Charisma save or Immobilized, save ends); 3-4 Yellow (DC 15 Dexterity save, 21 (6d6) Lightning, half on success); 5-6 Red (DC 15 Wisdom save or Staggered, save ends).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Four Tentacle attacks, then Reel, then one Bite.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 60 ft.; the target is Grappled (escape DC 15), Restrained, and at Disadvantage on Strength checks and saves while grappled; that tentacle can't grab another target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 5 ft., one creature it grapples; 16 (2d10 + 5) Piercing, and the target and its gear are swallowed into its Extraplanar Gullet.

actions.name: Reel
actions.description: Pulls each creature it grapples up to 30 feet straight toward it.

bonusActions.name: Dimensional Jump
bonusActions.description: Teleports up to 120 feet, or travels between the Material Plane and the Space Between Worlds.

reactions.name: Reality Hunter
reactions.description: When a creature it grapples tries to teleport, the teleport fails; the creature makes a DC 15 Intelligence save, taking 21 (6d6) Force on failure, or losing no resources on success.

monster:warp-witch.languages: the languages it knew in life
monster:warp-witch.damageResistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder
monster:warp-witch.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain, taking 5 (1d10) Force if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Balefire Lantern
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft.; 21 (4d8 + 3) Cold and Slowed until the end of the witch's next turn.

actions.name: Psychic Scream
actions.description: Intelligence save DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone: 10 (3d6) Psychic and Frightened (save ends) on failure.

actions.name: Possession
actions.description: Charisma save DC 13, one Humanoid it can see within 5 feet. On failure the witch vanishes into it; the target is Incapacitated and loses control of its body but stays aware. The witch can be targeted only by effects that turn undead, keeps its alignment, mental scores, and Charmed and Frightened immunity, and otherwise uses the target's statistics without its knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. It lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points, the witch leaves as a Bonus Action, or it is turned or expelled (as by Dispel Evil and Good); the witch then appears within 5 feet. A target that succeeds or is freed is immune for 24 hours.

bonusActions.name: Mutate Host
bonusActions.description: Charisma save DC 13, the creature it possesses: one Contamination level and a mutation on failure.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns unless it took Fire damage since its last turn; it dies only if it starts its turn at 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Slam attacks and one Bite; it can replace the Bite with Freezing Breath if available.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 5 ft.; 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing plus 9 (2d8) Cold and Slowed until the end of the troll's next turn. On a Critical Hit the target is Frozen (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 5 ft.; 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) Cold.

actions.name: Freezing Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Constitution save DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone: 18 (4d8) Cold and Frozen (escape DC 16), half damage only on success.

traits.name: Conditioned Obedience
traits.description: While it can see its creator, it has Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves.

actions.name: Rusty Surgical Blade
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing plus 7 (2d6) Poison.

reactions.name: Protective Impulse
reactions.description: When its creator within 10 feet is targeted by an attack or spell, it swaps places and becomes the target.

monster:young-delerium-dragon.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft.; passive Perception 20

traits.name: Aberrant Traits
traits.description: Has the Aberrant Traits described in Monsters of Drakkenheim.

traits.name: Epic Boss Hit Points
traits.description: Add 52 (5d10 + 25) to its Hit Points and Hit Dice for each player character above four, or subtract that much for each below four.

traits.name: Haze Aura
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic.

traits.name: Epic Actions
traits.description: It always acts on Initiative count 20, moving and interacting normally but taking no action or Bonus Action unless forced. Instead it takes one Epic Action at the end of each player character's turn.

legendaryActions.name: Bite
legendaryActions.description: Melee attack, +10, reach 10 ft.; 17 (2d10 + 6) Force, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 18) and Restrained while grappled.

legendaryActions.name: Contaminated Rend
legendaryActions.description: Constitution save DC 18, one creature within 5 feet: 14 (4d6) Necrotic and one Contamination level on failure.

legendaryActions.name: Tail
legendaryActions.description: Strength save DC 18, one creature within 20 feet: 14 (4d6) Force, and a Medium or smaller target is knocked Prone, on failure.

legendaryActions.name: Octarine Breath (Recharge 5-6)
legendaryActions.description: Dexterity save DC 18, each creature in a 30-foot Cone: 14 (4d6) Necrotic plus 14 (4d6) Psychic plus 14 (4d6) Radiant, half on success.

legendaryActions.name: Dimension Hop (1/Round)
legendaryActions.description: Teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

legendaryActions.name: Mage Hand
legendaryActions.description: Casts Mage Hand (invisible hand) using Charisma.

legendaryActions.name: Epic Resistance
legendaryActions.description: It picks one condition, spell, or effect on it and rolls 1d20; on 11 or higher that effect ends. Usable even when it can't act, is controlled, or has altered statistics.

traits.name: Unshakeable Faith (1/Day)
traits.description: When it fails a save, it can reroll with Advantage and must use the new roll.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing plus 7 (2d6) Radiant.

bonusActions.name: For the Flame (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: Allies within 60 feet that can hear it gain Advantage on attacks and saves until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.description: Advantage on melee attacks against a Bloodied creature.

traits.name: Blood Shield
traits.description: Whenever it damages a creature that has blood, it gains 15 Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and isn't in sunlight or running water, unless it took Radiant damage or holy water damage since its last turn.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

traits.name: Vampire Weaknesses
traits.description: Has the Vampire Weaknesses described in Monsters of Drakkenheim.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three attacks; it can replace one with Bite.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 10 (2d4 + 5) Slashing, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 21).

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Constitution save DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that is willing, Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained: 15 (3d6 + 5) Necrotic, its Hit Point maximum drops by that much, and it regains that many Hit Points.

bonusActions.name: Morrigan's Fury (1/Short Rest)
bonusActions.description: Gains Resistance to all damage except Acid and Radiant for 1 minute or until Incapacitated, and moves up to half its Speed toward a hostile creature without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

traits.name: Aversion to Faith
traits.description: Disadvantage on attacks while in a consecrated area or against a creature holding or wearing a Holy Symbol.

traits.description: Regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns unless it took Acid or Lightning damage since its last turn; it dies only if it starts its turn at 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing plus 5 (1d10) Cold.

actions.name: Tusks
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 5 ft.; 9 (1d8 + 5) Piercing plus 5 (1d10) Cold, and a Medium or smaller target is knocked Prone.
