traits.description: It has three heads (centipede hag, pigeon hag, weasel hag). Whenever it takes 50 or more damage in one turn, a random head dies; it dies when all are dead. At the end of each of its turns, if it has at least 1 Hit Point and a dead head, it regains 20 Hit Points and one dead head revives.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three attacks using Cauldron Slam or Brew Spray in any combination.

actions.name: Cauldron Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +9, reach 5 ft.; 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) Acid.

actions.name: Brew Spray
actions.description: Ranged attack, +7, range 90 ft.; 20 (4d8 + 2) Acid, and the target takes a -2 penalty to AC until the end of the abomination's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Charisma, save DC 18, no Material components. At will: Dispel Magic, Hypnotic Pattern. 1/day each: Contagion, Dominate Person, Dream.

legendaryActions.name: Corrosive Teleport
legendaryActions.description: Teleports up to 60 feet to a space it can see; each creature in a 10-foot Emanation at the destination makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 7 (2d6) Acid or half on success.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Leap
legendaryActions.description: Jumps to a space within 30 feet holding Large or smaller creatures; each there makes a DC 17 Dexterity save: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning and Prone, or half damage and pushed 5 feet away on success. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Hag's Head
legendaryActions.description: One option from a living head, each not again until the start of its next turn: Contagious Miasma (centipede; DC 18 Constitution save, one creature within 5 feet: 13 (3d8) Poison and Poisoned, unable to heal while Poisoned, resaving after each Long Rest; half damage only on success); Overwhelming Doubt (pigeon; DC 18 Wisdom save, one creature within 30 feet: 10 (3d6) Psychic and Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, half damage only on success); Waking Nightmare (weasel; DC 18 Charisma save, one creature within 30 feet: 11 (2d10) Psychic and Frightened, seeing its allies as enemies though not compelled to act, repeating the save each turn end and succeeding automatically after 1 minute; half damage only on success). (Legendary Action Uses: 3.)

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.description: If she fails a save, she can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Reopened Memories
traits.description: If at the start of her turn she sees a memento of her husband or another reminder of her loss, she has Disadvantage on D20 Tests and can spend only 2 Legendary Action uses until her next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Injection attacks.

actions.name: Injection
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +8, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft.; 1 Piercing plus 10 (3d6) Poison, and a creature is Poisoned until the end of its next turn with one effect of her choice (each once per turn): Hyperphobic Stimulant (Frightened, and at the start of its turn it makes a DC 16 Wisdom save or Dashes away from her by the safest route); Soporific Infusion (DC 16 Constitution save or Speed halved, only an action or a Bonus Action each turn, and one attack per Attack action, or Unconscious for 1 minute, until damaged, or until shaken awake on a failure by 5 or more); Thaumaturgic Inhibitor (when it casts a spell, it makes a DC 16 Constitution save or the spell fails without expending the slot).

legendaryActions.name: Alacrity
legendaryActions.description: She or a creature she is riding moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Dose
legendaryActions.description: One Injection attack. Not again until the start of her next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Hypertrophic Injections
legendaryActions.description: She or an ally within 5 feet gains one effect: Aggression (Advantage on attacks until the end of its next turn), Fortitude (ends one of Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Restrained, or Stunned), or Vigor (regains 10 Hit Points). Not again until the start of her next turn. (Legendary Action Uses: 3.)

monster:the-white-worm.senses: tremorsense 60 ft., truesight 60 ft.; passive Perception 14
monster:the-white-worm.languages: understands all languages but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

traits.name: Inscrutable Mind
traits.description: A creature that tries to read its mind makes a DC 19 Intelligence save or is Stunned, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and succeeding automatically after 1 minute.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If it fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Poisoned Knowledge
traits.description: If it uses Devour Mind on a creature that knows a special sequence of constellations and their path, at the start of that creature's next turn it takes 50 Psychic and Devour Mind ends.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: Burrows through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed, leaving a 10-foot-diameter tunnel.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Bite attack, and Psychic Caress on one or two creatures.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +15, reach 10 ft.; 25 (3d10 + 9) Piercing plus 7 (2d6) Force, and a Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 19).

actions.name: Psychic Caress
actions.description: Intelligence save DC 19, one creature it can see within 60 feet: 17 (5d6) Psychic and Frightened until the start of the worm's next turn, half damage only on success.

actions.name: Devour Mind (1/Day)
actions.description: It vanishes into the mind of a creature it can see within 60 feet (not one protected by Mind Blank or Protection from Evil and Good), taking no actions while the target watches it eat its memories and takes 88 (16d10) Psychic at the end of each of its turns. At 0 Hit Points the target is Stable but loses all memories permanently (only Wish restores them), and the worm reappears within 60 feet. It also ends if the target uses an action on a DC 20 Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma check and the worm then fails a Charisma save against that total; if the target receives an effect that ends possession, such as Dispel Evil and Good; or when the target takes damage, the worm takes half as much Psychic and fails a Charisma save with DC equal to that damage.

legendaryActions.name: Slither
legendaryActions.description: Moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendaryActions.name: Spawn Parasites
legendaryActions.description: Constitution save DC 20, each creature in a 60-foot Cone: on failure it is infested and Poisoned, taking 7 (2d6) Necrotic plus 7 (2d6) Psychic at the start of each of its turns; a creature killed this way rises 24 hours later as a Wormhost Surgeon. Anything that ends the Poisoned condition, or 10 or more Poison damage dealt to the host, kills the worms. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Strike
legendaryActions.description: One Bite attack. Not again until the start of its next turn. (Legendary Action Uses: 3, or 4 in Lair.)

monster:the-wicker-man.languages: understands all languages but can't speak
monster:the-wicker-man.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, incapacitated, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned, unconscious

traits.name: Burning Aura
traits.description: At the end of each of its turns, each creature of its choice in a 15-foot Emanation takes 5 (1d10) Fire, and creatures and flammable objects there start burning.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If it fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.description: Can take a Reaction on every turn of combat.

traits.name: Soul Motes
traits.description: It has 3 Soul Motes, gaining 1 when a creature that isn't a Construct or Undead dies within 30 feet, and resetting to 3 after a Long Rest. It spends them on Soul Mote Reactions.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Blazing Slam attacks.

actions.name: Blazing Slam
actions.description: Melee attack, +11, reach 15 ft.; 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) Fire.

actions.name: Cremating Flame (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot Cone: 35 (10d6) Fire, half on success. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points becomes ash and its soul is absorbed; it can't be revived until the Wicker Man is destroyed.

reactions.name: Crushing Blow (Soul Mote)
reactions.description: When it hits with an attack, it spends 1 Soul Mote to make the hit a Critical Hit.

reactions.name: Repair (Soul Mote)
reactions.description: When it starts its turn, it spends 1 Soul Mote to regain 20 Hit Points.

legendaryActions.name: Burning Clutch
legendaryActions.description: Strength save DC 19, one creature within 15 feet: Grappled (escape DC 16) by one of two hands and Restrained while grappled, taking 10 (3d6) Fire at the start of the Wicker Man's turn. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Slam
legendaryActions.description: One Blazing Slam attack. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Stride
legendaryActions.description: Moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. (Legendary Action Uses: 3.)

monster:the-wild-titan.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft.; passive Perception 20

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If it fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Runic Sever
traits.description: If it starts its turn within 50 feet of a stone at least 10 feet high and wide carved with the glyph of its forgotten creator, it takes 50 Necrotic and is Poisoned until its next turn.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: Deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Massive Fist attacks; it can replace one or both with Thrown Boulder.

actions.name: Massive Fist
actions.description: Melee attack, +17, reach 20 ft.; 28 (4d8 + 10) Bludgeoning, and a Huge or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 20) by one of two fists and Restrained while grappled.

actions.name: Thrown Boulder
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 25, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere on a point within 150 feet: 14 (4d6) Bludgeoning and Prone, half damage only on success.

actions.name: Wild Roar (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 19, each enemy in a 100-foot Emanation: Charmed until the start of its next turn, using its action to make its strongest attacks against the nearest creature it can see.

legendaryActions.name: Arm Sweep
legendaryActions.description: Dexterity save DC 25, each creature in a 20-foot Cone: 9 (2d8) Bludgeoning and Prone, half damage only on success. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Crushing Hurl
legendaryActions.description: Hurls a held object, a grappled creature, or a Large clod of earth to a space within 100 feet; each creature there, including a hurled one, makes a DC 25 Dexterity save: 19 (2d8 + 10) Bludgeoning and Prone, half damage only on success. Not again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Stomping Stride
legendaryActions.description: Moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, entering Huge or smaller creatures' spaces and pushing them to the nearest open space. (Legendary Action Uses: 3, or 4 in Lair.)

monster:vermin-familiar.speed: 30 ft., climb 30 ft., burrow 30 ft. (Centipede or Weasel only), fly 60 ft. (Pigeon only)
monster:vermin-familiar.senses: blindsight 30 ft. (Pigeon only), darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft. (Centipede only); passive Perception 15

traits.name: Disparate Incarnation
traits.description: It takes a Centipede, Pigeon, or Weasel body, which sets some traits and actions.

traits.name: Fear of Canines
traits.description: If it sees a dog, wolf, or other canine at the start of its turn, it is Frightened until its next turn, with Disadvantage on saves meanwhile.

traits.name: Flyby (Pigeon Only)
traits.description: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Spider Climb (Centipede Only)
traits.description: Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

traits.name: Vermin Telepathy
traits.description: It can telepathically control Beasts and swarms matching its incarnation (including giant versions, Boogleswarms, Skitterswarms, and Squabswarms) within 120 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee attack, +6, reach 5 ft.; 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing plus 3 (1d6) Psychic.

actions.name: Incarnated Assault (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: By incarnation, against one creature it can see within 5 feet, half damage only on success: Confounding Scratch (Weasel; DC 12 Charisma save, 21 (6d6) Necrotic and affected by Confusion until the start of its next turn); Infectious Sting (Centipede; DC 12 Constitution save, 10 (3d6) Poison and Poisoned and Paralyzed until the end of its next turn); Terrifying Flutter (Pigeon; DC 12 Wisdom save, 21 (6d6) Psychic and Frightened until the end of its next turn, fleeing by the safest route).

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: Casts Invisibility on itself without components, using Wisdom.

monster:vermin-infestation.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft.; passive Perception 15
monster:vermin-infestation.conditionImmunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Infighting
traits.description: A creature that suggests the swarm's members are plotting against each other as an Influence action and succeeds on a DC 15 Charisma (Deception) check deals it 10 Necrotic.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: Can share another creature's space and fit through openings large enough for a Tiny creature; it can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Shred
actions.description: Melee attack, +6, reach 5 ft.; 14 (4d4 + 4) Piercing, or 9 (2d4 + 4) while Bloodied, and a Medium or smaller target in its space is Grappled (escape DC 14), one at a time. At the start of each of the grappled creature's turns, roll 1d6: 1-2 Centipede Sting (4 (1d8) Poison and Poisoned until its next turn); 3-4 Pigeon Cry (10 (3d6) Psychic); 5-6 Weasel Drain (5 (1d10) Necrotic, reducing its Hit Point maximum by that much).

monster:wayward-haint.damageResistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder
monster:wayward-haint.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Bottle Trap
traits.description: If it enters the space of an upright empty bottle, it makes a DC 16 Charisma save or is drawn inside and stoppered, seeing and hearing out to 10 feet and audible within that range, until the bottle breaks or is opened.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain, taking 5 (1d10) Force if it ends its turn inside a solid object.

actions.name: Draining Regret
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 10 (3d6) Psychic and 1 Exhaustion level (never above 5); these levels end after a Short or Long Rest or Lesser Restoration or similar magic.

traits.name: Biting Gift
traits.description: If a creature willingly offers her one of its teeth, she must accept and is Charmed for 24 hours or until that creature or its allies damage her or force her to save.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.description: Within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, she can cast Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Lucky Charm (lasting until she casts it again or ends it), or Unseen Servant, each once per Long Rest, without Material components, using Intelligence.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Bite attack, and she uses an at-will Spellcasting spell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +6, reach 5 ft.; 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing plus 10 (3d6) Psychic.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Charisma, save DC 13, no Material components. At will: Blindness/Deafness, Detect Magic, Ray of Enfeeblement. 1/day each: Confusion, Dream.

actions.name: Waking Terrors (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 13, one creature she can see within 30 feet (Disadvantage if she holds one of its teeth): 21 (6d6) Psychic and Frightened, seeing its allies as nightmare foes though not compelled to harm them, repeating the save each turn end and succeeding automatically after 1 minute; half damage only on success.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.description: Becomes a Tiny weasel (Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft.) or a Small or Medium Humanoid, or returns to her true form, keeping her statistics except size and weasel Speed; gear doesn't change.

monster:wellwyrm.senses: blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft.; passive Perception 16

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: Can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Hunting Terror
traits.description: When it hears a horn or similar instrument played, it is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: One Bite attack, and it uses Constrict.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 10 ft.; 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing plus 21 (6d6) Poison.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Strength save DC 16, one Medium or smaller creature it can see within 5 feet: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning and Grappled (escape DC 14), Restrained while grappled; it spends no extra movement moving the grappled creature.

monster:wildpyre-large.damageResistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder
monster:wildpyre-large.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain, taking 5 (1d10) Force if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Quenching Water
traits.description: Any water affects it as Holy Water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Blazing Rend attacks, and Flame Bind if available.

actions.name: Blazing Rend
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 5 ft.; 8 (1d8 + 4) Necrotic plus 7 (2d6) Fire, the target starts burning, and a creature no larger than it is knocked Prone.

actions.name: Flame Bind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 15, one creature it can see within 60 feet: Restrained, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns; on its turn it can end the condition by taking 6 (1d12) Fire plus 6 (1d12) Necrotic.

monster:wildpyre-medium.damageResistances: Acid, Bludgeoning, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, Thunder
monster:wildpyre-medium.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain, taking 5 (1d10) Force if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Quenching Water
traits.description: Any water affects it as Holy Water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Blazing Rend attacks, and Flame Bind if available.

actions.name: Blazing Rend
actions.description: Melee attack, +7, reach 5 ft.; 8 (1d8 + 4) Necrotic plus 7 (2d6) Fire, the target starts burning, and a creature no larger than it is knocked Prone.

actions.name: Flame Bind (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 15, one creature it can see within 60 feet: Restrained, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns; on its turn it can end the condition by taking 6 (1d12) Fire plus 6 (1d12) Necrotic.

actions.name: Cursed Scratch
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing plus 3 (1d6) Necrotic, and a creature has Disadvantage on attacks until the start of the witchwoven's next turn.

reactions.name: Protective Bond
reactions.description: When a creature it can see within 60 feet takes damage, that creature gains Resistance to it and the witchwoven takes 10 (3d6) Force.

monster:woodwarped.damageVulnerabilities: Slashing from battleaxes, greataxes, and handaxes

traits.name: Aversion to Axes
traits.description: If it sees a creature holding a Battleaxe, Greataxe, or Handaxe at the start of its turn, it is Frightened until its next turn.

traits.name: Thorns
traits.description: At the start of each of its turns, it deals 5 (2d4) Piercing to each creature grappling it or grappled by it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +6, reach 5 ft.; 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing plus 4 (1d8) Poison, and a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) by one of two claws.

actions.name: Thorn Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation (Disadvantage if it grapples them): 14 (4d6) Piercing and Poisoned, repeating the save each turn end and succeeding automatically after 1 minute; half damage only on success.

reactions.name: Splintered Propagation (1/Day)
reactions.description: When it takes Slashing damage not from a Battleaxe, Greataxe, or Handaxe, a fragment grows into a Small woodwarped within 5 feet with 10 Hit Points, only the Claw action, and no Reaction, acting on its Initiative.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: Regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns unless it took Poison damage since its last turn; it dies only if it starts its turn at 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Veiled Ignorance
traits.description: A creature whose mind can't be read, or that is under Mind Blank or Nondetection, is Invisible to it, even to its Blindsight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Bone Saw attacks.

actions.name: Bone Saw
actions.description: Melee or ranged attack, +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft.; 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing plus 4 (1d8) Psychic. On a Critical Hit a creature's Intelligence drops by 1d4, killing it at 0.

actions.name: Infested Spray (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 14, each creature in a 20-foot Cone: 17 (5d6) Psychic and infested with larval worms, taking 7 (2d6) Psychic at the end of each of its turns until it takes Poison damage or an effect ends the Poisoned condition on it; half damage only on success. A creature this damage kills dies, and a Humanoid slain this way rises 24 hours later as a wormhost surgeon.

reactions.name: Protective Parasite
reactions.description: When it drops to 0 Hit Points, the parasite in its brain spits acid: each creature in a 20-foot by 5-foot Line makes a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 10 (3d6) Acid or half on success.

monster:serum-brute.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius unless Unleashed Eyes is active); passive Perception 15

traits.name: Curse Dependent
traits.description: If targeted by Remove Curse or similar magic, it loses its Blindsight, Withering Eye, and Cursed Gaze until it finishes a Long Rest.

traits.name: Stimulant Rush
traits.description: At the start of its turn it picks one, never the same twice in a row: Catalyst Infusion (until its next turn, Speed 50 feet, no Opportunity Attacks when leaving reach, long jump 30 feet and high jump 15 feet without a running start); Caustic Secretion (until its next turn, Fist deals an extra 11 (2d10) Acid); Stim Boost (10 Temporary Hit Points).

traits.name: Unleashed Eyes (1/Day)
traits.description: When it becomes Bloodied, its sealed eyes tear open: it is no longer blind beyond 60 feet and can use Withering Eye and Cursed Gaze until it finishes a Long Rest.

traits.name: Withering Eye (Unleashed Eyes Only)
traits.description: When it moves within 5 feet of a creature, that creature takes 4 (1d8) Psychic, once per turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Two Fist attacks, and Cursed Gaze if available.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee attack, +8, reach 10 ft.; 9 (1d8 + 5) Bludgeoning, plus 11 (2d10) Acid while Caustic Secretion is active.

actions.name: Cursed Gaze (Unleashed Eyes Only)
actions.description: Wisdom save DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone: 9 (2d8) Psychic and Frightened until the start of its next turn, half damage only on success.

reactions.name: Devotion
reactions.description: When an ally within 5 feet takes damage, the ally gains Resistance to it and the brute takes Psychic damage equal to the damage the ally takes.

monster:skitterswarm.languages: understands Common and Sylvan but can't speak
monster:skitterswarm.conditionImmunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned

traits.name: Body Burrowing
traits.description: If it sees a Humanoid corpse at the start of its turn, it must move toward it and, once there, stay for 1 hour, after which the flesh putrefies.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.description: Can share another creature's space and move through openings large enough for a Tiny centipede; it can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Vile Vermin
traits.description: A creature that starts its turn in its space makes a DC 12 Constitution save or contracts a magical contagion, unable to regain Hit Points and resaving after a Long Rest or when an effect ends the Poisoned condition on it; on success it is immune to all skitterswarms' contagion for 24 hours.

actions.name: Infesting Bite
actions.description: Melee attack, +4, reach 5 ft.; 7 (2d6) Piercing, or 3 (1d6) while Bloodied, and a centipede infests a creature, dealing 3 (1d6) Necrotic at the start of each of its turns until it regains Hit Points or an effect ends the Poisoned condition on it.

monster:great-fir-drake.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft.; passive Perception 19

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: As a Bonus Action it sheds Dim Light in a 15-foot radius, or Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for 15 feet more; it ends the light as a Bonus Action.

traits.name: Prickly Pines
traits.description: A creature that hits it with a melee attack takes 4 (1d8) Piercing.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If it fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Three Rend attacks; it can replace one with Incandescent Breath or with Spellcasting to cast Color Spray.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee attack, +9, reach 10 ft.; 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing plus 7 (2d6) Radiant.

actions.name: Incandescent Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 19, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line: 55 (10d10) Radiant, half on success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Intelligence, save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks, no Material components. At will: Color Spray, Detect Magic, Faerie Fire. 1/day each: Hypnotic Pattern, Major Image, Plant Growth.

legendaryActions.name: Bright Tail Lash
legendaryActions.description: Strength save DC 17, one creature it can see within 15 feet: 10 (3d6) Radiant and knocked Prone on failure.

legendaryActions.name: Pounce
legendaryActions.description: Moves up to half its Speed and makes one Rend attack.

legendaryActions.name: Twinkling Lights
legendaryActions.description: Uses Spellcasting to cast Faerie Fire.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: Explodes when it dies: Dexterity save DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation: 7 (2d6) Fire, half on success.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: If it doesn't move on its turn, it has Advantage on the Hide action.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee attack, +5, reach 5 ft.; 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Dexterity save DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone: 7 (2d6) Fire, half on success.

actions.name: Create Gremlin (1/Day)
actions.description: If within 10 feet of an ordinary pudding, it turns that pudding into another pudding gremlin, which appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it and acts as its ally.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.description: No magic can observe it remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission, and Wisdom (Insight) checks to read its intentions or sincerity have Disadvantage.
